draft.subject: Industrial AI for upstream and downstream operations – introduction to the Digital & Industrial fund
draft.body:
Dear Aramco Ventures Team,

I am Narges Farahani from Parsa International Group, an Istanbul-based company that develops AI software for oil, gas and process operations. Given the Digital & Industrial fund's focus, I would like to introduce our work.

Our product lines include:
- Real-time field monitoring and analytics for oil and gas assets;
- Formation-damage detection and prevention during drilling, completion and production;
- AI-based artificial-lift optimisation;
- Gas-turbine and process digital twins with predictive maintenance;
- Energy, emissions and carbon management with reinforcement-learning optimisation.

The software is at advanced-prototype stage (TRL 4-5), developed and tested on synthetic and simulated data. Our next step is a field pilot with an operator to validate it on real data, and we are raising seed funding to support that.

We would welcome a short call to understand whether a pilot through Aramco's technology programmes, or an investment discussion at a later stage, could be relevant.

Best regards,

Narges Farahani
AI Sector
Parsa International Group
Istanbul, Türkiye

draft.subject: Parsa International Group – AI that runs predictive maintenance and diagnostics on low-cost hardware
draft.body:
Dear Y Combinator Team,

We are Parsa International Group, an Istanbul-based team building AI software that turns scarce specialist work in industry and healthcare into software that runs on inexpensive hardware.

What we have built:
- Industrial AI for oil, gas and process plants: field monitoring, predictive maintenance, gas-turbine digital twins and energy/emissions optimisation;
- An AI lab interpreter for diagnostic tests (qPCR/ELISA): automated quality control and result calls with confidence levels, running offline on low-power lab devices;
- Multimodal early-risk assessment for Alzheimer's and Parkinson's disease.

Where we are, honestly: working prototypes (TRL 4-5) developed on synthetic and simulated data, no paying customers yet. The next step is our first pilots with an energy operator and a diagnostic laboratory.

Why now: operators and labs in emerging markets lack specialists, and the hardware to run these models locally is now cheap enough to deploy at scale.

We would like to apply to an upcoming batch and would value any guidance on how best to present a company at our stage.

Best regards,

Narges Farahani
AI Sector
Parsa International Group
Istanbul, Türkiye
